perf_3_runs_10m_plus_100k_warmup.cache: LLC misses around 0.02–0.03% of reported cache references. L1 load-miss counter always zero, so unsuitable for L1 conclusions in this VM.

interpretation: Zen5 benefits from avoiding 16 SIMD byte extracts per round and enforcing four independent short XOR chains. Seed round keys into the first partial accumulator to remove key XOR from final reduction dependency. This uses more integer instructions and loads but substantially improves IPC. Broadwell has a different tradeoff and must retain a separately measured backend. None of these experiments proves a physical optimum.
notes: Microbenchmark ranges summarize several independent runs and code-shape matrices; compare variants within their recorded run because VM scheduling and CPU clock changes add noise.
These experiments test single-block dependency latency, rather than bulk throughput. The retained bulk backend has separate measurements.
No evidence here establishes a physical performance optimum.
All tested kernels were checked against the pre-change table implementation before timing. The gather prototype additionally passed 10,000 randomized block comparisons.

byte_sliced_lfsr.correctness: Each candidate: 32 runtime keys, 64 arbitrary plaintext blocks per key and 64 arbitrary ciphertext blocks per key, encryption and decryption checked against scalar reference and original seven-multiplication kernel; roundtrip also checked. Final candidate matrix passed all 16 tests; full coefficient-choice matrix passed all 19 tests.

algebra.six_flat_multipliers: 148*a0 XOR 133*a2 XOR 16*a3 = a0 XOR 133*(a0 XOR a2) XOR 16*(a0 XOR a3)
algebra.winning_seven_multipliers: Compute 148*critical separately. Replace 148*independent XOR 133*a2 XOR 16*a3 with independent XOR 133*(independent XOR a2) XOR 16*(independent XOR a3). XOR the separate critical product with the complete independent sum only at the end.
algebra.critical_byte: Forward R: state[0]; inverse R: state[15].
algebra.independent_byte: Forward R: state[14]; inverse R: state[1].

byte_sliced_lfsr.assembly_observation: The third vm-constrained operand of xor3 became stack memory even for computed vector values. Register-only v constraints removed those stores and memory dependencies. The fastest algebra keeps the newest feedback in one GFNI multiplication followed by one final XOR.
rejected: Naive six-multiplication algebra with original vm xor3 operands: around 10.8 ns/block versus 5.3 ns/block original; correctness passed but throughput regressed.
Register-only xor3, six products by eliminating coefficient 148, 133, or 16: still slower than unsplit seven-product register-only kernel.
Five-TERNLOG partition replacing final XOR saved one instruction per R but did not consistently improve measured performance; retain the simpler final-XOR reduction.

expanded_round_key_broadcast.hypothesis: Expand each of 160 round-key bytes into a repeated-byte u32, once per bulk call (640-byte temporary), then use VPXORD with m32{1to16} instead of byte broadcast followed by XOR.
expanded_round_key_broadcast.baseline: Final seven-multiplication critical-feedback split, register-only GFNI matrices, direct key-byte broadcasts, register-only XOR3 and transpose operands.
expanded_round_key_broadcast.correctness: All 20 tests passed, including 256 key-byte XOR primitive values and 16 runtime random keys with arbitrary plaintext encryption and arbitrary ciphertext decryption per candidate. All timed workload output checksums agreed with baseline.

implementations.explicit_pointer: One pointer-based VPXORD m32 broadcast with a memory clobber preserving key initialization.
implementations.literal_offset: One VPXORD m32 broadcast using a shared key-row pointer plus compile-time byte displacement.
implementations.native_u32_vector: Pure Zig u32-lane XOR with @splat(u32); assembly retained separate VPBROADCASTD and XOR instructions.

expanded_round_key_broadcast.result: Reject as a new production path: prep-inclusive throughput differences were approximately 0–1%, changed with run/operation, and did not establish a material consistent gain. No Cipher field or public API changes.
expanded_round_key_broadcast.assembly: Correct explicit-pointer versions emitted single VPXORD DWORD BCST instructions; a preliminary scalar m-constraint draft failed correctness and was excluded from every recorded timing.
